verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Ente Auth is a cloud-synced service, so a buyer could fairly ask whether their data is used for AI training. However, the evidence contains no policy, setting, or statement about AI model training. End-to-end encryption and offline 'Use without backups' mode are adjacent privacy controls, not a documented commitment or control that prevents training use, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
